channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: Alloop unveils Trio: a modular wearable built around an AI health agent you can talk to
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Alloop unveiled Trio, a modular 3-in-1 health wearable with a sensing core that swaps between a ring and a wristband in seconds. The hardware is built around a conversational AI Health Agent that combines sensor data with voice-recorded daily context, plus an open platform that pulls in Apple Health, Google Health, and Health Connect. A Kickstarter is expected in November 2026.

item.title: Meta launches Muse in Japan: the AI agent's first stop outside North America
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Meta's personal AI agent Muse launched in Japan on October 23, 2026 — its first market outside North America. It sends emails and books travel on users' behalf, with Klook live at launch and Mercari and Money Forward integrations on the way.

item.title: Spot rising AI terms days before keyword tools do: a hands-on guide to new-term-radar
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: zhuyansen/new-term-radar (MIT, 1,700+ GitHub stars) runs a daily AI-keyword radar over X, Hacker News, GitHub trending, Hugging Face and site sitemaps - standard-library Python, no key needed for the free signals, one pay-per-call key for the rest. Here is how to run your own.

item.title: Hi3D open-sources Sparc3D as V1.0: the production-tested 3D model, now free to use
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Hi3D open-sourced Hi3D V1.0 — the 3D-generation model formerly known as Sparc3D — on October 23, 2026, after expanding its training set from roughly 500,000 to two million curated 3D assets, with free generation on the official Hi3D website.

item.title: Sakana AI unveils Aquarium: one shared playbook for enterprise AI agents
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Sakana AI introduced Aquarium on October 23, 2026: a managed foundation that lets enterprise AI agents share data definitions, decision rules, and operating controls, built on a business ontology drawn from the lab's finance-sector work.

item.title: Reverse-engineer anything with one 8 KB skill: a hands-on guide to leanrea
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: aicodeking/leanrea (MIT, 1,400+ GitHub stars) replaces the 207-tool REA MCP server with a single 8 KB skill file — 38% faster and 35% cheaper in the author's benchmark. Here's how to install it and reverse-engineer a real app with your coding agent.

item.title: TanStack AI hits 1.0: the lock-in-free agent toolkit goes stable
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: TanStack shipped TanStack AI 1.0 on October 23, 2026, stabilizing its framework-agnostic agent toolkit — 23 provider adapters, 11 sandbox providers, and an experimental harness with durable sessions.

item.title: MiniMax open-sources M3.1 Flash: the 428B "Space Bunny" agent model lands on Hugging Face
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: MiniMax open-sourced the weights of M3.1 Flash on October 23, 2026 — the 428-billion-parameter agent model that spent ten days topping OpenRouter’s charts as the anonymous "Space Bunny." The weights are on Hugging Face with day-one vLLM and SGLang support.

item.title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work — one of the largest enterprise AI agent rollouts yet
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Uber is expanding OpenAI's ChatGPT Work agent from a 1,000-person pilot to its entire global workforce of 30,000 people, with GPT-6.1 Sol as the default model — a signal that enterprise AI agents are moving from experiments to everyday infrastructure.

item.title: iFlytek's Spark X2.6 is a 293B AI model trained entirely on Chinese chips — no NVIDIA in sight
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: iFlytek launched Spark X2.6 at its 1024 Developer Festival: a 293-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with a 1-million-token context window that the company says was trained entirely on domestic Chinese computing power — plus an open-source 4B edge variant.

item.title: NVIDIA launches Minerva: an AIOps platform that predicts AI-factory failures before they kill your training run
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: NVIDIA unveiled Minerva, an AIOps platform for end-to-end AI-factory observability. It stitches telemetry from GPUs, networking, storage, schedulers and workloads into a live knowledge graph, uses machine learning to predict failures, and collapses alert storms into single incidents. IREN is already live; Tesla, IBM and five more plan to deploy.

item.title: Hugging Face's Carbon-X lets you 'chat with DNA': a 14.8B open model that reads raw genomes and answers in plain English
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Hugging Face released Carbon-X, an open 14.8B-parameter model that reads raw DNA in a chat conversation and answers in English — scoring near OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Sol on DNA benchmarks at roughly 1/1,800 the cost per problem, with no wet-lab validation yet.

item.title: From bare terminal to agentic workstation: a hands-on guide to Hermes Agent's official plugins
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Nous Research's hermes-official-plugins (MIT, 378 GitHub stars) is the reviewed plugin catalog for the self-improving Hermes Agent. This tutorial installs the agent with one command, then wires up four official plugins: Spotify control, Home Assistant, a Claude-subscription model provider, and Langfuse tracing.

item.title: Cohere takes Model Vault confidential: verifiable, hardware-backed AI inference enters public beta
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Cohere launched the public beta of Confidential Computing on Model Vault, its managed inference platform — NVIDIA H100 GPUs on Microsoft Azure running inside hardware-isolated enclaves, with remote attestation so customers verify the environment before sending a byte.

item.title: Manchester road-tests NVIDIA and UW's RFD4-Proteina: 4 of 67 AI-designed enzymes worked, the best converting 79%
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: University of Manchester researchers tested AI-designed enzymes for a key step in making lenacapavir with the new RFD4-Proteina protein model — 4 of 67 designs showed activity, best hitting 79% conversion.

item.title: Canva launches Craft, its first homegrown image model — it sketches the picture before painting it
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Canva unveiled Craft, its first image model built and trained from scratch by its in-house lab, Canva Research — a two-stage system that plans the composition before rendering at up to 2K. Live today for all 250 million users in Dream Lab and via the public API.

item.title: METR red-teams OpenAI’s internal AI watchdog — and finds ways agents could slip past it
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: METR and Redwood Research spent three weeks embedded inside OpenAI stress-testing the monitor that watches its agents for misalignment. They found novel ways to evade it — and published their account on October 22, 2026.

item.title: 1Password for Agents: your AI agent can sign in to your accounts without ever seeing the password
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: 1Password launched 1Password for Agents on October 22, 2026 — a sign-in platform that lets personal AI agents like Meta's Muse and SpaceXSI's Grok Bot log in to your accounts while the password itself never leaves your vault.

item.title: One AI agent across your phone, desktop and browser: a hands-on guide to nanoMuse
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: nanoMuse (nano-muse/nanoMuse, GPL-3.0-or-later, ~2,300 GitHub stars) is an open-source personal agent that runs on your phone, your computer and your browser under one account — doing tasks instead of just answering questions, handing control across devices, and asking before anything you can’t undo. This tutorial takes the browser demo for a spin, installs the desktop app, links a phone, and self-hosts the relay.

item.title: Rivals donate to the same home: Anthropic, OpenAI, Hugging Face and Alibaba hand four agent projects to the Agentic AI Foundation
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The Agentic AI Foundation announced four new hosted projects on October 22, 2026 — Agent Skills from Anthropic, Open Responses from OpenAI, OpenEnv from Hugging Face, and OpenSandbox from Alibaba — taking the foundation from three projects to ten in its first year.

item.title: Ai2 precomputes the entire planet: OlmoEarth v1.3 turns a year of satellite data into ready-made embeddings
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The Allen Institute for AI released OlmoEarth v1.3 today — a satellite embedding model with precomputed annual embeddings for the whole planet at 10-meter resolution, a no-sign-in browser explorer, benchmark wins over Google's AlphaEarth on 20 of 27 tests, and a final pretraining bill of about $2,720 in rented H100 time.

item.title: Enact exits stealth with a $30M pre-seed to teach robots to feel — Yann LeCun and Mistral’s Arthur Mensch back the bet
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Zurich-based Enact Intelligence has come out of stealth with a $30M (€26.68M) pre-seed round — one of the largest in Europe to date — to give robots force-and-touch dexterity through their own actuators, backed by redalpine, Notion Capital, firstminute capital, Yann LeCun, Arthur Mensch, Andrew Lonsberry, and Hugging Face’s Thomas Wolf.

item.title: SUNMI pushes ‘Physical AI’ into the shop floor: new Hi SUNMI agent, Intel-built Windows devices, and a platform behind 40,000 merchants
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: At its SDC 2026 developer conference in Shanghai, the Hong Kong-listed commercial-hardware maker (06810.HK) unveiled the Hi SUNMI AI agent for physical stores, a family of Intel-based Windows devices including the FLEX 3 WIN and T3 PRO WIN, and SUNMAX’s Magic AI agent platform — staking its claim on ‘Physical AI’ for commerce.

item.title: Assembler AI raises $4M seed to put computer vision over the factory workbench
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The Montreal startup's Operator Vision cameras watch manual assembly stations and flag missed steps, wrong parts, and cycle-time drift in real time — now backed by Diagram ClimateTech Fund and a CEO with 25 years of AI company-building behind him.

item.title: WISeQey launches WISMind.AI: a trust layer for autonomous AI agents with verifiable IDs and quantum-proof credentials
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: WISeQey on Thursday launched WISMind.AI, a trust platform that gives autonomous AI agents cryptographically verifiable identities, signed and revocable permissions, and post-quantum-secure credentials anchored in a Swiss root of trust — with a developer program opening in the coming months.
